model_annotation: This plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores" and spans from -1.0 to 0.6 on a linear scale, with tick labels at regular intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Counts" and shows values ranging from 0 to 8000 on a linear scale. A single blue line with circular markers is displayed, beginning at a count of approximately 40 at a polarity score of -1.0. The line increases to a maximum count of approximately 7800 at a polarity score of 0.1, then decreases to a count of approximately 1800 at a polarity score of 0.6.
